gap: No result ChatGPT got states that UGREEN's cheapest NAS, the NASync DH2300 ($239.99 on UGREEN's US store today), cannot run Docker at all according to UGREEN's own FAQ. That rules out the Docker WordPress + MariaDB + Cloudflare Tunnel setup ChatGPT recommended. The DH4300 Plus ($373.99) runs Docker but not virtual machines, and only the DXP models run both.
standout_why: ChatGPT's saved chat shows an empty search list, so there were no cited rival pages or top results to compare against. Its answer only says 'If your NAS supports Docker (Container Manager on supported Synology models)'. It never says which models are excluded, and it names no UGREEN model. Our current page lists the DXP2800 Docker route but says nothing about the DH2300 or DH4300 Plus.
decides: It removes the UGREEN DH2300 from any 'host WordPress at home' pick even though it is the cheapest UGREEN box. Among UGREEN models, the cheapest that can run the WordPress, MariaDB and cloudflared containers is the DH4300 Plus at $373.99 (ARM64; all three official images ship an arm64 build). The x86 DXP2800 costs $389.99, $16 more, and adds VM support for isolating WordPress. It also confirms the DXP2800 row on our page. On the Synology side, Container Manager ships both x86_64 and armv8 builds, so Docker is not limited to the Plus models. The changelog names ARMv8 models (DS223, DS420j, DS220j, DS120j) that gained support. The WordPress package itself is a single build with no CPU-specific variants.

findings.label: Docker support
findings.value: Not supported. UGREEN: "No. The DH2300 does not officially support Docker."
findings.source_title: UGREEN NAS Software and UGOS Pro FAQs
findings.note: The maker's FAQ (nas.ugreen.com redirects here). Without Docker, the WordPress/MariaDB/cloudflared container stack can't run, and UGREEN has no WordPress app of its own.

findings.label: Docker / VM support
findings.value: Docker yes; virtual machines no ("The DH2300 and DH4300 Plus do not support virtual machines.")
findings.source_title: UGREEN NAS Software and UGOS Pro FAQs
findings.note: The FAQ lists the DH4300 Plus with the DXP models as Docker-capable. It also says Docker support does not guarantee that UGREEN supports any given third-party container.

findings.label: Docker / VM support
findings.value: Docker yes; Virtual Machine Manager yes ("Only DXP models support Virtual Machine Manager.")
findings.source_title: UGREEN NAS Software and UGOS Pro FAQs
findings.note: The FAQ names the DXP2800, DXP4800 Plus, DXP4800 Pro, DXP2800 GT, DXP4800 GT, DXP6800 Pro, DXP8800 Plus and DXP480T Plus as Docker-capable.

findings.label: WordPress official Docker image, CPU architectures
findings.value: amd64, arm64/v8, arm/v7, arm/v5, 386, ppc64le, s390x, riscv64
findings.note: Tag last updated 2026-11-16. The arm64 build means it runs on the ARM DH4300 Plus and on ARMv8 Synology models.

findings.label: MariaDB official Docker image, CPU architectures
findings.note: Tag last updated 2026-11-12. There is no arm/v7 build, so old 32-bit ARM NAS units can't run the official MariaDB container.

findings.label: Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) Docker image, CPU architectures
findings.note: Tag last updated 2026-11-12. The tunnel ChatGPT recommended runs in a container on x86 and ARM64 NAS units, so it needs a Docker-capable model and rules out the DH2300.

findings.label: Container Manager builds
findings.value: Current 24.0.2-1707 ships two builds: ContainerManager-armv8 and ContainerManager-x86_64
findings.note: The maker's package archive. The armv8 build means Docker isn't limited to x86 Plus models.

findings.label: Container Manager model additions (maker changelog)
findings.value: 20.10.23-1405 (2023-05-22) added DS420j and DS223; 20.10.23-1437 (2023-09-19) added DS220j and DS120j; 24.0.2-1630 (2026-05-06): models incompatible with that version should install 24.0.2-1606
findings.source_title: Synology Release Notes for Container Manager (API)
findings.note: Newest entry is 24.0.2-1707, published 2026-11-05. The changelog does not name the DS223j or DS124.

findings.label: Container Manager compatibility (named reviewer)
findings.value: Mariushosting lists the DS223j and DS223 (23 series), DS124 (24 series) and DS225+ (25 series) as Container Manager-compatible, with no restriction noted
findings.source_title: Mariushosting: Can I Run Docker on My Synology NAS?
findings.note: The page was updated 2026-09-28. Only some old models (DS415+, DS713+, DS412+, DS1010+) are flagged Docker-only, not Container Manager.

findings.label: WordPress package build
findings.note: There are no per-CPU builds, unlike Container Manager. That fits the native Web Station route not depending on CPU architecture, but I couldn't read Synology's applied-models list.

findings.label: WordPress app dependency
findings.value: QNAP's QTS 5.0 tutorial has you enable Web Server, then install Container Station, then install WordPress from App Center
findings.source_title: QNAP: How to install WordPress on QTS 5.0?
findings.note: Last modified 2022-03-04. No models or QuTS hero are named. It warns: "The Username and Password should not be the same as your NAS User name and Password."

unsourced: Synology's applied-models lists for Container Manager and WordPress: synology.com/dsm/packages/ContainerManager and /WordPress load the list with JavaScript, and WebFetch returned only an empty 'Applied Models' heading. So I have no maker confirmation that the DS223j and DS124 specifically get Container Manager.

Synology's QuickConnect services list (kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/Which_services_support_QuickConnect): the article body is rendered by JavaScript and didn't load, so I couldn't verify the maker's wording on whether Web Station sites work over QuickConnect.
Synology kb tutorial 480 ('How do I host a website on my Synology NAS?'): the body also didn't load, so I have no maker-stated minimum DSM, PHP or MariaDB versions for the WordPress package.
Whether UGREEN plans Docker for the DH2300 in a future UGOS Pro release: the FAQ says 'does not officially support' and I found no UGREEN announcement of plans.
